old_rule: mu_j=mean_train X_j; sigma_j=sqrt(mean_train (X_j-mu_j)^2); scale_j=sigma_j except exact-zero sigma_j replaced by1; Z=(X-mu)/scale. Nearzero nonzero sigma was not bounded.

new_rule.formula: mu_j=mean_T X_j; var_j=mean_T (X_j-mu_j)^2; s_RMS=sqrt(mean_j var_j); scale_j=max(sqrt(var_j),s_RMS); Z_j=(X_j-mu_j)/scale_j; if allvariancezero:unit scales.

causal_scope: One changed scaling rule, fresh same-initialization head warmstarts required. Same frozen image/prefix caches, trainable stage, input224, activation, optimizer grid, seeds, epochs, orders, folds, and nested selection. No validation-derived floor or prediction clipping.
mechanism: Rare nearconstant train feature divided by very small train standard deviation amplified heldout feature values and FP32 device differences before and after fine-tuning. Fixed train-only RMS floor removed the observed amplification. It also changes relative feature scaling and therefore learned predictions; numerical repair alone does not imply accuracy improvement.
interpretation_limits: ResNet standalone improved but fixed blend did not; observed residual correlation increased. This observation does not prove a causal decomposition of blend performance.
Both fixed10 blends lost against021 on all5folds; no promotion or resplits.
Family OOF scores are diagnostics only; no outer-label choice of optimizer family.
Reused development400 with a long adaptive research history, not an independent final test.
Fixed12epochs does not establish convergence or a CNN architecture ceiling.
Input resolution, deeper unfreezing, activation and augmentation were not changed or executed.
